testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-percent-off-order-promotion-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify percent off order promotion functionality

scenario.summary: A registered user (the promotion's profile) adds two products at quantity 1 and checks that an automatic Percent Off Order promotion gives no discount below the order minimum, then raises one line past the minimum and checks a discount of at least the percent of the subtotal with order total = subtotal - discount. After logout a guest adds the same products and gets no discount. No order is placed.
steps: Sign in with username/password (empty storage state) and empty the cart
Add sku1 and sku2 at quantity 1, open the cart (2 lines), check there is no discount
Raise the sku1 line (name1) to updatedQuantity, reload; check the quantity and the 'Discount (On Sub Total)' label
Read subtotal, discount, order total: order total = subtotal - discount; discount >= discountAmount% of subtotal (stacking with other promotions is only warned)
Empty the cart, check the empty-cart message, log out
As guest: add sku1 and sku2 at quantity 1, open the cart, check there is no discount, empty the cart
stateChanges: Registered user's cart and a guest cart: products added, quantity raised, emptied
The promotion is only read; no order is placed
assertions: No discount with both products at quantity 1
Raised line quantity equals updatedQuantity; discount label 'Discount (On Sub Total)' visible
Order total close to subtotal - discount (precision 2)
Empty cart message visible; sign-in link visible after logout
Guest: no discount with both products at quantity 1
evidence: Title: 'verify percent off order promotion functionality'; spec note: AUTO 10% order promotion, signed-in user = the selected profile; guest check in step 6
Spec note: on atstage Schlage (z-2100012) also carries a ~20% category promotion that stacks; the test asserts discount >= 10% only
atstage (read-only rows): PromoPercentOffOrder on MaxwellsHardware is 10% automatic with OrderMinimum 650

User decision: quantities computed from the resolved promotion's orderMinimum and unit prices; products PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK with maxPrice 100 each (quantity-1 cart < $200, below every observed order minimum); sku1 (~$120 on atstage) cannot qualify, so no preferred source
quantityUsed 100 for the raised line (upper bound of the computed quantity), 1 for the other
Promotion profile 'Retail Customer' (default registered profile, assumed to be the declared user's), allProfiles false (guest check in step 6)
